question:
**Directions: Identify the segment in the sentence which contains a grammatical error.**

The little baby cried loudly to a new toy.
solution:
The correct answer is 'to a' **i.e.** this part of the sentence has an error.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given sentence, the use of the preposition 'to' is incorrect.
 
• The preposition 'to' means **in the direction of; as far as**.
